key: JULIA: Hihi, \PN!
en: JULIA: Hihi, \PN!
ja: ジュリア: はろー、\PN!

key: Welcome to the Super-Duper Ultra-Hyper Electro- Dazzle Happy Boom-Time House of Cheer!
en: Welcome to the Super-Duper Ultra-Hyper Electro- Dazzle Happy Boom-Time House of Cheer!
ja: ようこそ、スーパーデュパー・ウルトラハイパー・エレクトロ・キラキラハッピー・ドッカンタイム応援ハウスへ!

key: Just ignore all the superlame reality junk.
en: Just ignore all the superlame reality junk.
ja: ダサいリアルな話は全部無視してね。

key: I need more banners! And streamers! And... hm...
en: I need more banners! And streamers! And... hm...
ja: もっと横断幕! もっと紙テープ! それと……うーん……

key: ...Ways to cover up the persisting revelation that the best years of my life are already behind me and from now on everything is an inevitable decline!!!
en: ...Ways to cover up the persisting revelation that the best years of my life are already behind me and from now on everything is an inevitable decline!!!
ja: ……人生の一番いい時期はもう終わって、これからはひたすら下り坂だっていう、消えない事実を隠す方法とかね!!!

key: Wait, is that a safety hazard?
en: Wait, is that a safety hazard?
ja: あ、それって危険じゃない?

key: Oh, who cares?!
en: Oh, who cares?!
ja: まあ、どうでもいっか!?

key: Anyway, don't think I'll go easy on you just because you're the one he chose!
en: Anyway, don't think I'll go easy on you just because you're the one he chose!
ja: とにかく、あんたが「あの人」に選ばれたからって、アタシが手加減すると思わないでよね!

key: As former captain cheerleader, I have to convince myself that the Onyx Trainers' School's honor depends on me!
en: As former captain cheerleader, I have to convince myself that the Onyx Trainers' School's honor depends on me!
ja: 元チアリーダー部長として、オニキストレーナーズスクールの名誉はアタシにかかってるって、自分に言い聞かせなきゃ!

key: OTS, we represent! We pack a punch and don't relent!
en: OTS, we represent! We pack a punch and don't relent!
ja: OTS代表! パンチは効かせて手加減なし!

key: All right, all right, all right! I'm wired so let's--
en: All right, all right, all right! I'm wired so let's--
ja: よし、よし、よし! テンションMAXだし、いくよ――

key: CAIN: Heyyy, you're cute.
en: CAIN: Heyyy, you're cute.
ja: カイン: よぉ、かわいいね。

key: You come around here often?
en: You come around here often?
ja: ここらへんによく来るの?

key: Ahaha, just kidding~
en: Ahaha, just kidding~
ja: あはは、冗談だよ~

key: Man, \PN, I am SO glad to see you.
en: Man, \PN, I am SO glad to see you.
ja: いやー\PN、会えて超うれしいよ。

key: I mean, I thought I had stars in my eyes, but I guess it was just you~
en: I mean, I thought I had stars in my eyes, but I guess it was just you~
ja: 目がキラキラしてると思ったら、お前だったんだねぇ~

key: But really, I've been wandering around here for a while and I was starting to get worried.
en: But really, I've been wandering around here for a while and I was starting to get worried.
ja: でも本当、しばらくここをうろうろしてて、ちょっと心配になってきてたんだよね。

key: I have no idea how I got here, or what's going on,
en: I have no idea how I got here, or what's going on,
ja: どうやってここに来たのか、何が起きてるのかもさっぱり分かんないけど、

key: But what do you say we stick together until we figure out what's what in this place?
en: But what do you say we stick together until we figure out what's what in this place?
ja: 状況がつかめるまで、一緒に行動しない?

key: Then again, there's only one path, so I guess that won't be hard.
en: Then again, there's only one path, so I guess that won't be hard.
ja: まあ、道は一本しかないから、難しくはなさそうだけどね。

key: C'mon, let's go~
en: C'mon, let's go~
ja: ほら、行こ~

key: FERN: \PN.
en: FERN: \PN.
ja: ファーン: \PN。

key: A little birdie told me you were coming here to challenge my sister.
en: A little birdie told me you were coming here to challenge my sister.
ja: 風のうわさで　聞いたぜ。テメーが　オレ様の姉貴に　挑みに来るってな

key: I'm forced to ask myself,
en: I'm forced to ask myself,
ja: どうしても　考えちまうんだよ

key: Why?
en: Why?
ja: なぜだ?

key: Here's what I think, \PN.
en: Here's what I think, \PN.
ja: オレの考えはこうだよ、\PN。

key: I think you don't deserve to challenge her.
en: I think you don't deserve to challenge her.
ja: テメーに　姉貴へ挑む資格は　ねぇ

key: I think you're not good enough.
en: I think you're not good enough.
ja: テメーは　力不足なんだよ

key: Not even I was good enough.
en: Not even I was good enough.
ja: オレでさえ、十分じゃなかったんだ。

key: Maybe you don't understand why I'm doing this, \PN.
en: Maybe you don't understand why I'm doing this, \PN.
ja: なんでオレがこんなことしてるのか、\PNには分かんないかもね。

key: It's not like it's a matter of pride.
en: It's not like it's a matter of pride.
ja: プライドの問題ってわけじゃないんだ。

key: But you're worthy.
en: But you're worthy.
ja: でもお前にはその資格がある。

key: And I never was.
en: And I never was.
ja: オレには、一度もなかったけど。
